summary: EasyDeL, an open-source JAX framework for training, fine-tuning, and serving large models on TPU and GPU, with many model architectures, specialized trainers, distributed sharding, and the eSurge inference engine.

GitHub repo for AQT (Accurate Quantized Training), a JAX library for int8 quantization of matmuls and einsums during training and serving, with installation, a Flax configuration example, Flax/Pax support, serving conversion, and the underlying quantization math.

MaxDiffusion repository: pure JAX reference implementations of latent diffusion models (Stable Diffusion, SDXL, Flux, Wan video, LTX-Video) for training and image/video generation inference on Cloud TPUs and GPUs, with LoRA, ControlNet and caching features.

MaxText GitHub repository: open-source JAX library for high-performance LLM pre-training and post-training (fine-tuning, SFT, RL) on Cloud TPUs and GPUs, with reference implementations of Gemma, Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek and other models and scaling to thousands of chips.

GitHub repo for Qwix, a JAX quantization library for quantization-aware training (QAT) and post-training quantization (PTQ): supported int/fp8 numeric types and schemes, and how to configure quantization rules and apply them to Flax models.

RecurrentGemma repository: Google DeepMind's open-weights model based on the Griffin architecture (local attention plus linear recurrences for fast long-sequence generation), with install steps, checkpoints from Kaggle, sampling and fine-tuning examples, and JAX/PyTorch support on CPU, GPU and TPU.

JAX implementation of Ring Attention with Blockwise Transformers for very long (million-token) context on TPU/GPU: shards sequence across devices with shard_map, overlapping key/value passing with compute; covers install, chunk sizes, causal blocks, and checkpointing.

torchax library for running PyTorch models on TPU through JAX: installation, how the tensor subclass wrapping jax.Array works, compiling with jax.jit, mixing PyTorch and JAX code, and saving checkpoints.

API reference for the jax.dlpack module, for exchanging tensors between JAX and other frameworks via DLPack: from_dlpack to convert an external DLPack tensor into a JAX array and is_supported_dtype to check dtype compatibility.
